newsitem.title: USA: MVSI TO ACQUIRE SOFTWARE FIRM TECHNET.
newsitem.headline: MVSI TO ACQUIRE SOFTWARE FIRM TECHNET.

text.p: MVSI Inc on Wednesday said it has entered into a letter of intent to acquire privately held Technet Computer Services Inc, in a proposed exchange of securities.
MVSI will exchange 400,000 restricted shares of MVSI common stock for all the outstanding shares of Technet.
Once acquired, Technet would become a wholly owned subsidiary of MVSI.
MVSI said Technet is a Virginia-based computer software development company. The company predicts that its off-the-shelf products will provide them with $7-10 million in sales over the next year.

MVSI believes these estimates could change once the proposed acquisition of Technet by MVSI is completed and the management, marketing and financial resources of MVSI are available to expand Technet's marketing and sales operations, particularly in the Year 2000 market.
MVSI said the acquisition of Technet should be completed on or before September 1.
